description: What intake admission (.github/scripts/intake-triage/admit.mjs) requires before it adds agent-ready to an issue apply-verdict set to status: ready (#9212's ten criteria, owner decision Q51). Agents may change it; no floor or sync binds it (owner decision 2026-10-22). `parent-container-labels` marks a spec container parent, which /work-items:decompose always labels needs-human, so needs-human on it does not hold its children; it must hold the tracker binding's container label (docs/conventions/work-items.yaml tracker.config.container_label, default spec-container), and a missing key reads as empty. `own-agents` names the identities whose own filings admission takes with no person (ADR 0111): `identities` lists `lanes-app` (the lanes App, whatever its id) or a Bot account's numeric id, and `source-cap` is how many open issues one `source: <producer>` label may hold before the next one waits. List only an identity whose filings never carry outside text: never github-actions[bot], which any workflow on GITHUB_TOKEN acts as; it stays trusted only for upstream-drift issues. A missing key reads as identities [lanes-app] and source-cap 5.
